text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P99 decode latency spike detected on prod-gpu-cluster-us-east-1. Streaming stalls seen on /v1/stream endpoints. p95 jumping from ~180ms -> ~1.2s, p99 -> ~2.8s. Alerts: SLO-breach (p99 > 2s). Correlation: kernel build `trt8-flashattn-v3` deployed 00:58 UTC.

marta: oncall here, ack. seeing lots of stalled frames in the streaming logs, clients get partial chunks then freeze. grabbing dashboards.

leo: I'm seeing the spike in decode tail specifically on 8k sequences. top nodes show increased pagefault and nvlink retries.

samir: any deploys around that time?

marta: yes, infra deploy rolled `trt8-flashattn-v3` at 00:58 from the infra rollout job.

leo: repro snippet from host logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T00:59:03Z] decode_kernel: flash_attn_kernel_launch failed status=13, retrying with fallback
[2026-03-15T00:59:03Z] kvcache: eviction spike, seq_len=8192, tokens_processed=12000
[2026-03-15T00:59:03Z] stream: write stalled waiting for decode chunk, client_id=acct-123
```

irene: customer impact: monitoring shows 18 tenants with >3s tail; top 5 impacted include chat-prod-1 (high traffic). We've opened a CS queue for any escalations.

samir: initial mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel to `trt8-flashattn-v2` 2) disable flash-attn path via runtime flag 3) route streaming traffic to dedicated older-pinned pools. Which do we want now?

marta: start quick rollback to previous kernel for the priority pools (canary first). I'll request infra rollback. Also toggle runtime flag for broader safety: `runtime.cfg.features.flash_attn=false`.

eng-sre-bot: Running canary rollback job: `infra-deploy rollback --cluster prod-us-east-1 --service inference-runtime --to-tag trt8-flashattn-v2 --pool priority`

leo: also flip the runtime flag across pods (hot patch) to disable flash-attn fallback path for 00:05. Command: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/inference-runtime FLASH_ATTENTION=false --context=prod-us-east-1
```

marta: doing rollback + flag flip in parallel. monitoring traces.

(5m later)

marta: rollback canary completed, initial canary p99 dropped from 2.7s -> 420ms. Rolling to remaining priority pools now.

samir: good. Is there any risk of increased CPU cost if we disable flash-attn fallback?

leo: yes some nodes will see higher CPU/GPU utilization; we have buffer in dedicated pools. We'll watch downscales.

irene: update to CS: several customers saw degraded streaming; we advised them we are rolling a hotfix and expect restoration within 30m. No data loss reported.

marta: full rollback of trt8-flashattn-v3 to v2 complete at 01:15 UTC across prod-us-east-1. Global p95/p99 returned close to baseline for most routes. Leaving runtime flag disabled until further validation.

eng-sre-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0315-042. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback.

samir: next steps for root cause: collect build artifacts for v3 and compare kernel symbols vs v2; run the flash-attn microbench on staging with the v3 build and long-sequence workload. Also check compiler flags used for v3 (note: CI shows `-Ofast -march=native -mfma -funroll-loops` enabled).

leo: I pulled the v3 build log: link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/9876 (internal). There's a change in nvcc flags: `-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80` addition and `--use_fast_math` turned on. Might affect FP behavior in flash-attn kernel and cause retries/paging under high seq lengths.

marta: creating a follow-up task for build team to reproduce and add regression test with seq=8192+; also need a rollback-safe release gating.

irene: CS asked for timeline for a permanent fix — say 48-72h for full root-cause and a tested v3 with guardrails.

marta: handing off to next oncall (leo). Summary for handoff: 
- Incident: P99 decode tail latency spike correlated with `trt8-flashattn-v3` kernel deploy at 00:58 UTC.
- Mitigation: rolled back to `v2` across prod-us-east-1 by 01:15 UTC; disabled flash-attn runtime flag as defense-in-depth.
- Current status: services stable, p99 near baseline, monitoring on 5m.
- Open actions: capture v3 artifacts, reproduce in staging (samir + build), add seq=8k regression test, add CI gate to block kernel flags change.
- Customer impact: 18 tenants affected transiently; CS notified.

leo: ACK. I'll own monitoring for the next 6h, and coordinate with build team to get a reproducer. Also will follow up with Product/PMG for communicating a postmortem.

samir: leaving notes in the build ticket about compiler flag hypothesis. If we can reproduce locally I'll propose a patch changing `--use_fast_math` -> off and drop that specific gencode.

marta: thanks—if anything regresses escalate to P1 immediately. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
